§3§lSharing the Same Input§r
A mirror lets another machine share the source matrix's §1ordered input§r §1without copying materials§r.

§3§lPlacement and Binding§r
Build the destination to match the source layout, replacing only §1one corresponding compartment§r with a mirror. After source §1processing has finished and its buffers are empty§r, §1left-click a source compartment§r with a GT Data Stick, then §1right-click the corresponding mirror§r to bind it.

§3§lConnection Requirements§r
Keep both groups §1loaded in the same dimension§r. §1Do not connect the destination to ME§r.
